name: HTML training lab
description: A self-contained, GitHub Pages-ready HTML lab guide with a story arc, left navigation, collapsible labs, copyable prompts, and self-checks.
best_for: Browser-based training with no hosting dependencies

required_inputs.name: title
required_inputs.description: The title of the training session.

required_inputs.name: audience
required_inputs.description: Learner roles and starting skill level, without personal details.
required_inputs.example: Fictional Zava project coordinators who are new to Cowork

required_inputs.name: learning_objectives
required_inputs.description: Observable tasks learners should be able to complete.
required_inputs.example: Draft a launch brief, compare options, and check the draft against requirements

required_inputs.name: scenario
required_inputs.description: A wholly fictional Zava-style business story; never use tenant data.
required_inputs.example: Zava is preparing a fictional product launch using invented source documents

required_inputs.name: duration_minutes
required_inputs.description: Total time available for the workshop.

name: Word training guide
description: A .docx training guide plus a one-page quick reference, written by a skill and saved using Cowork's own tools.

required_inputs.name: topic
required_inputs.description: The workflow or capability the guide teaches.
required_inputs.example: Turn a fictional Zava project brief into a review-ready plan

required_inputs.name: audience
required_inputs.description: Learner roles and starting skill level, without personal details.
required_inputs.example: Fictional Zava operations teams with basic Copilot experience

required_inputs.name: learning_objectives
required_inputs.description: Observable tasks covered by the guide and quick reference.
required_inputs.example: Prepare a prompt, review the result, and refine a plan

required_inputs.name: duration_minutes
required_inputs.description: Expected time to work through the guide.

name: Cowork demo pack
description: Fictional source documents, seeded email content, and calendar event drafts for a Cowork demo; this server never creates mailbox or calendar items.

required_inputs.name: scenario
required_inputs.description: A wholly fictional Zava-style business situation.
required_inputs.example: Zava needs to resolve an invented launch-readiness scheduling conflict

required_inputs.name: demo_goals
required_inputs.description: Capabilities the demonstration should make visible.
required_inputs.example: Synthesize fictional source documents and draft a follow-up plan

required_inputs.name: fictional_roles
required_inputs.description: Role labels for invented participants; do not provide real person names.
required_inputs.example: Zava launch coordinator, Zava reviewer, Zava facilitator

name: Prompt-a-thon
description: A facilitated prompt challenge session with timed rounds, fictional scenarios, peer review, and a shared reflection.

required_inputs.name: audience
required_inputs.description: Participant roles and experience level, without personal details.
required_inputs.example: Fictional Zava teams with mixed Copilot experience

required_inputs.name: challenge_theme
required_inputs.description: A fictional Zava-style workflow to explore in challenge rounds.
required_inputs.example: Improve an invented Zava workshop plan

required_inputs.name: success_criteria
required_inputs.description: How participants should evaluate and discuss prompt results.
required_inputs.example: Clear instructions, grounded fictional details, and actionable next steps

required_inputs.name: duration_minutes
required_inputs.description: Total session time, including the final reflection.
